'''November 2000 Presque Isle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Presque Isle, Maine on 4 November 2000. It is known from Jayke Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1416">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-presque-isle-maine-11-04-00d1416/ presque-isle-maine-11-04-00], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 5 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-presque-isle-maine-11-04-00d1416/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Presque Isle, Maine
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
